```{r}
zeroA <- read.csv(here("00_data/02_motifs/0A_MX/01b_INPH_hmm00A_MX000019.csv"))


zeroA$q.value<- as.numeric(zeroA$q.value)
zeroA$p.value<- as.numeric(zeroA$p.value)
zeroA$score<- as.numeric(zeroA$score)



### remove any duplicate motifs (occasionally a motif will be a palindromic and hit both + and - strands) 
zeroA <- zeroA %>%
  group_by(sequence_name, start, stop) %>%  # group by coordinates
  slice_max(order_by = score, n = 1) %>%    # keep only the row with highest score
  ungroup()

### phi3T KY030782, spbeta AF020713
## redrock (actino phage with ParABS) GU339467, uses zeroA sites but of a different type than sporulation zeroA

zeroA <- zeroA %>% separate(X, into=c("Accession2"), sep="\\.", extra="drop", remove =FALSE)

zeroA$sequence_name[is.na(zeroA$sequence_name)] <- "no_hit"
zeroA$sequence_name <- ifelse(zeroA$sequence_name=="no_hit", zeroA$Accession2, zeroA$sequence_name)
```

```{r}
#inph <- select(inph, Accession, Host, Genome.Length..bp., gtdb_f, f_spor, newgtdb_Phylum,  host_phage_spor, phage_type, sporulation, lifestyle, nice)
all <- merge(df, zeroA, by.x="Accession", by.y="sequence_name", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)
all$motif_id[is.na(all$motif_id)] <- "no_hit"

#all$hit <- ifelse(all$motif_id=="0A_STORMO", 1, 0)
all$hit <- ifelse(all$motif_id=="0A_MX000019", 1, 0)
all$p.value <- ifelse(all$hit==1, all$p.value, 1)
all$q.value <- ifelse(all$hit==1, all$q.value, 1)
all$q.value[is.na(all$q.value)] <- 1
all$p.value[is.na(all$p.value)] <- 1

all$q.adjust <- p.adjust(all$p.value, method = "BH")
```

```{r}
### threshold testing

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
#all <- subset(all, all$p.value>1-08)
# Define thresholds



thresholds <- 10^seq(-9, -1, by = 1)   # from 1e-6 to 1e-1
thresholds <- c(thresholds, 0.05, 1)      # add 0.05 explicitly if desired
results <- lapply(thresholds, function(th) {
  all %>%
    group_by(Accession, phage_spor_host, dataset) %>%
    summarise(
      pos.zeroA.hit = max(ifelse(!is.na(q.adjust) & q.adjust <= th, 1, 0)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    group_by(phage_spor_host, dataset) %>%
    summarise(
      Phage_has_0A = sum(pos.zeroA.hit),
      total.phage = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      box.pos.perc = Phage_has_0A / total.phage * 100,
      threshold = th
    )
}) %>% bind_rows()
```

```{r}
zeroA.qual <- all

## create binary list of phages w/ and w/out ParS hits

  summarise(total.boxA.hits = sum(hit), pos.boxA.hit = max(hit), .groups = "drop") #%>% 

only.pos <- subset(boxA.sanity, boxA.sanity$total.boxA.hits>0)



boxA.summary <- boxA.pos %>% 
  group_by(phage_spor_host) %>% 
  summarise(
    total_boxA_hits = sum(total.boxA.hits, na.rm = TRUE),
    Phage_has_boxA = sum(pos.boxA.hit, na.rm = TRUE),

  ) %>% 
  mutate(boxA.pos.perc = Phage_has_boxA / total.phage * 100)


boxA.bin <- boxA.pos[,c(1,2,4)]
```

### Enrichment
```{r}
# -----------------------------
pairwise_fisher_both_directions <- function(df, group_col, hits_col, total_col, p.adjust.method = "BH") {
  
  groups <- unique(df[[group_col]])
  combs <- combn(groups, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  
  results <- data.frame(
    group1 = character(),
    group2 = character(),
    odds_ratio = numeric(),
    conf_low = numeric(),
    conf_high = numeric(),
    p.value = numeric(),
    p.adj = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  pvals <- numeric()
  
  for (c in combs) {
    g1 <- df[df[[group_col]] == c[1], ]
    g2 <- df[df[[group_col]] == c[2], ]
    
    tab <- matrix(c(
      g1[[hits_col]], g1[[total_col]] - g1[[hits_col]],
      g2[[hits_col]], g2[[total_col]] - g2[[hits_col]]
    ), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
    
    rownames(tab) <- c(c[1], c[2])
    colnames(tab) <- c("Present", "Absent")
    
    ft <- fisher.test(tab)
    
    # group1 vs group2
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      group1 = c[1],
      group2 = c[2],
      odds_ratio = ft$estimate,
      conf_low = ft$conf.int[1],
      conf_high = ft$conf.int[2],
      p.value = ft$p.value,
      p.adj = NA
    ))
    
    # group2 vs group1 (inverse OR)
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      group1 = c[2],
      group2 = c[1],
      odds_ratio = 1 / ft$estimate,
      conf_low = 1 / ft$conf.int[2],
      conf_high = 1 / ft$conf.int[1],
      p.value = ft$p.value,
      p.adj = NA
    ))
    
    pvals <- c(pvals, ft$p.value, ft$p.value)
  }
  
  results$p.adj <- p.adjust(pvals, method = p.adjust.method)
  return(results)
}

```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Compute Fisher tests
t <- pairwise_fisher_both_directions(
  df = boxA.summary,
  group_col = "phage_spor_host",
  hits_col = "Phage_has_boxA",
  total_col = "total.phage",
  p.adjust.method = "BH"
)

# Specify pairs of interest (with direction)
selected_pairs <- list(
  c("Lytic Non-Bacillota", "Temperate Non-Bacillota"), 
  c("Lytic Nonsporulating Bacillota", "Temperate Nonsporulating Bacillota"),
  c("Lytic Sporulating Bacillota", "Temperate Sporulating Bacillota"),
  c("Temperate Sporulating Bacillota", "Temperate Nonsporulating Bacillota"),
  c("Lytic Sporulating Bacillota", "Temperate Nonsporulating Bacillota"),
  c("Lytic Sporulating Bacillota", "Lytic Nonsporulating Bacillota"),
  c("Lytic Sporulating Bacillota", "Temperate Sporulating Bacillota")
)

pairs_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(selected_pairs, function(x) {
  data.frame(group1 = x[1], group2 = x[2], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}))



pairwise_res_subset <- t %>%
  semi_join(pairs_df, by = c("group1", "group2")) 



pairwise_res_subset <- pairwise_res_subset %>%
  mutate(
    label_combined = ifelse(
      p.adj < 0.05,
      ifelse(
        p.adj < 0.0001,
        paste0("OR=", round(odds_ratio, 2), ", p<0.0001"),
        paste0("OR=", round(odds_ratio, 2), ", p=", signif(p.adj, 3))
      ),
      "n.s."
    )
  )
```

##### Kruskal
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Count positives and totals per group
n_counts <- df_all %>%
  group_by(phage_spor_host) %>%
  summarise(
    positive = sum(total.boxA.hits > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    total    = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    perc  = round(100 * positive / total, 1),
    label = paste0(positive, "/", total, " (", perc, "%)")
  )

# -----------------------------
kruskal_res <- kruskal.test(total.boxA.hits ~ phage_spor_host, data = df_all)
#print(kruskal_res)

# -----------------------------
# Define comparisons
comparisons_list <- combn(unique(df_all$phage_spor_host), 2, simplify = FALSE)

# Bar placement settings
offset <- 1     # push bars higher than max data
y_step <- 1.5   # vertical spacing
y_start <- max(df_all$total.boxA.hits, na.rm = TRUE) + offset

# Compute raw p-values
pairwise_res <- lapply(seq_along(comparisons_list), function(i){
  comp <- comparisons_list[[i]]
  x <- df_all$total.boxA.hits[df_all$phage_spor_host == comp[1]]
  y <- df_all$total.boxA.hits[df_all$phage_spor_host == comp[2]]
  wt <- wilcox.test(x, y)
  data.frame(
    group1 = comp[1],
    group2 = comp[2],
    p.value = wt$p.value,
    y.position = y_start + (i - 1) * y_step
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

# Adjust p-values (BH)
pairwise_res$p.adj <- p.adjust(pairwise_res$p.value, method = "BH")

# Label formatting
pairwise_res <- pairwise_res %>%
  mutate(
    label = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.0001 ~ "p < 0.0001",
      p.adj < 0.05   ~ paste0("p = ", signif(p.adj, 3)),
      TRUE           ~ "n.s."
    )
  )

# -----------------------------
levels_order <- c(
  'Lytic Sporulating Bacillota',
  'Temperate Sporulating Bacillota',
  'Lytic Nonsporulating Bacillota',
  'Temperate Nonsporulating Bacillota',
  'Lytic Non-Bacillota',
  'Temperate Non-Bacillota'
)



```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(rstatix)


df_all <- boxA.pos %>%
  mutate(host_phage_spor = factor(phage_spor_host, levels = levels_order))

df_violin <- df_all %>%
  filter(total.boxA.hits > 0)

# --- n counts ---
n_counts <- df_all %>%
  group_by(phage_spor_host) %>%
  summarise(
    positive = sum(total.boxA.hits > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    total    = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    perc  = round(100 * positive / total, 1),
    label = paste0(positive, "/", total, " (", perc, "%)")
  )

# --- Stats ---
# Kruskal–Wallis
kw_res <- kruskal_test(df_all, total.boxA.hits ~ phage_spor_host)

# Pairwise Wilcoxon with BH correction
wilc_test <- df_all %>%
  pairwise_wilcox_test(total.boxA.hits ~ phage_spor_host,
                       p.adjust.method = "BH") #%>%

wilc_test <- wilc_test %>% unite(col = "test", c("group1", "group2"), remove = FALSE, sep = "_")


### subset tests you want to show
wilc_test <- subset(wilc_test, wilc_test$test=="Lytic Sporulating Bacillota_Temperate Sporulating Bacillota" |
                      wilc_test$test=="Lytic Nonsporulating Bacillota_Lytic Sporulating Bacillota" |
                      wilc_test$test=="Lytic Non-Bacillota_Lytic Sporulating Bacillota" |
                      wilc_test$test=="Temperate Nonsporulating Bacillota_Temperate Sporulating Bacillota" |
                      wilc_test$test=="Lytic Nonsporulating Bacillota_Temperate Nonsporulating Bacillota" |
                      wilc_test$test=="Lytic Non-Bacillota_Temperate Non-Bacillota")



max_y <- max(df_all$total.boxA.hits, na.rm = TRUE)
step <- .85
wilc_test <- wilc_test %>%
  mutate(y.position = max_y + rev(seq(1, nrow(.)))*step)


# Make label: OR not relevant here (Wilcoxon), so p only
wilc_test <- wilc_test %>%
  mutate(
    p_label = ifelse(p.adj < 0.0001, "p < 0.0001",
              ifelse(p.adj < 0.05, paste0("p=", signif(p.adj, 3)), "n.s."))
  )



  
# --- Plot ---
pd <- position_jitter(width = 0.25, height = 0.25)

) +
```
